join hortbot 999 foobar 1

clock_set 2000-10-01T03:11:00Z

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there! (_MESSAGE_COUNT_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme 0_*_*_*_*
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has been scheduled with '0 * * * *' and will run if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 10m
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 50m
sleep 100ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello there! 3

checkpoint
clock_forward 30m
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule off repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Scheduled command 'repeatme' is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 1h
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Scheduled command 'repeatme' is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 1h
sleep 100ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello there! 7


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule delete repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' is no longer scheduled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 1h
sleep 100ms
no_send
